## What would you like to report?

Use the [issue chooser](https://github.com/Sankofa-Digital-Studio/sankofa-computelab/issues/new/choose) for a bug report or an improvement proposal.

## Outcome or problem

Describe the affected learner, lecturer, or contributor task and the expected result.

## Evidence and verification

For bugs, give the reproduction steps, build, device, and browser. For improvements, state the proposed outcome and how a reviewer can verify it. Use synthetic or redacted examples. Keep student data, credentials, and confidential assessment material out of issues.

For vulnerabilities, follow the [security policy](https://github.com/Sankofa-Digital-Studio/sankofa-computelab/security/policy).
